title: From Patterns to Threats: A Deep Learning Model for Anomaly Detection in Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.29903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cyber-physical systems increasingly rely on interconnected sensing, communication, and control components, creating a need for reliable detection of abnormal behavior. This study proposes a Deep Autoencoder for anomaly detection using the Edge-IIoTset dataset. After preprocessing the full dataset, 2,219,201 observations and 38 numerical features were retained. The proposed model employed a 38-24-12-6-12-24-38 encoder-decoder architecture and was trained exclusively on normal observations to learn representative patterns of expected system behavior. Anomaly decisions were based on reconstruction error, with the classification threshold selected independently from validation data by maximizing the F1-score. To assess model stability, five independent runs were conducted using different random seeds, and results were reported as mean plus or minus standard deviation. The proposed Deep Autoencoder achieved an accuracy of 0.9195 plus or minus

translated_title: 从模式到威胁：一种用于信息物理系统异常检测的深度学习模型
translated_abstract: 信息物理系统日益依赖于相互连接的传感、通信和控制组件，因此需要对异常行为进行可靠检测。本研究提出了一种深度自编码器，并使用Edge-IIoTset数据集进行异常检测。在对完整数据集进行预处理后，保留了2,219,201条观测数据和38个数值特征。所提出的模型采用38-24-12-6-12-24-38的编码器-解码器架构，仅在正常观测数据上进行训练，以学习预期系统行为的代表性模式。异常判断基于重构误差，分类阈值通过在验证数据上最大化F1分数独立选取。为评估模型稳定性，研究使用不同随机种子进行了五次独立运行，并以均值加减标准差的形式报告结果。所提出的深度自编码器达到了0.9195（加减标准差）的准确率。
tldr: 本研究提出一种仅在正常数据上训练的深度自编码器，通过重构误差和验证集上F1分数优化的阈值，在Edge-IIoTset数据集上实现了信息物理系统异常检测约0.92的准确率。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a Deep Autoencoder trained exclusively on normal observations, using reconstruction error with an F1-optimized threshold, achieving 0.9195 accuracy for anomaly detection in cyber-physical systems on the Edge-IIoTset dataset.
